summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X Ethereum Covered Call ETF (EHCC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long eth, short usd currency. The fund is actively managed, offering Ether (ETH) price exposure while prioritizing high-income potential and periodic distributions. The fund uses a synthetic covered call strategy built on US-listed spot and futures-based Ether ETPs EHCC was launched on Apr 1, 2026 and is issued by Global X.
